title: Carry evidence packs in the one sync command for the full committed profile
outcome: Carry evidence packs in the one sync command for the full committed profile
acceptance: The one sync command, on a data branch whose committed profile includes evidence, exchanges evidence packs as the adopted joint design (note 8c2e1b94d7c04bcd8a9c022a735fa39a, Kimi 74c82235556f49ce9b8dcf09431aae19) specifies, with evidence on by default for a new full profile
A behaviour test drives the command end to end against a local remote with evidence packs in both directions
docs/shipped.md and the git-task-sync brief state what the command exchanges
